primary_region: distal M1, M1/M2 bifurcation, proximal M2

reference_inlet.method: cardiac-cycle-averaged phase-contrast MRI volume flow, each MCA
reference_inlet.sensitivity_definition: reported mean plus/minus one SD, not a universal normal range
reference_inlet.diameter_provenance: repository MCA nominal anatomy, not patient-specific measured diameter

robot_reference.speed_source: Supplementary Table 4, printed page 39; TRAINING domain-randomization swarm velocity, not measured individual robot swimming speed in blood
robot_reference.nominal_speed_reason: upper end of the reported training range; optimistic engineering proxy, not calibrated maximum thrust
robot_reference.radius_provenance: unmeasured engineering sensitivity; 0.08 mm approximates the old 0.0011-unit robot at nominal MCA scale; NOT the paper's 1.25-1.75 mm-wide swarm
robot_reference.latency_source: supplement printed pages 30-31, end-to-end delay under 30 ms
robot_reference.control_period_provenance: 50 ms / 20 Hz is an engineering assumption allowing time beyond the reported delay; paper does not establish this update rate
robot_reference.actuation_constraint: the reference uses a shared three-axis Helmholtz field; independent per-agent velocity commands in existing MARL are not hardware validated

geometry_validation.provenance: procedural nominal anatomy; not patient-specific segmentation or an imported SimVascular mesh

occlusion_sensitivity.extent_provenance: engineering sweep of local radius reduction, not calibrated thrombus permeability or mass-to-lumen law
occlusion_sensitivity.distal_provenance: unmeasured terminal resistance relative to healthy resolved-tree resistance; report all cases, never select by navigation success

numerics.substep_policy: report required adaptive substeps; never lower physical speed to meet compute budget

blocking_items: hardware speed and effective body size in blood not measured
shared-field actuation versus independent agent commands unresolved
outlet impedance and obstructed flow not calibrated
lysis rate per second and mass-to-lumen law not calibrated
physical substeps, exit boundaries and obstacle dynamics not integrated into RL workers

flow_model_limitations: equal terminal reference pressures, optional unmeasured distal resistance, fixed driving pressure calibrated to healthy flow
no measured outlet impedance, autoregulation or pulsatile waveform
no stenotic jet or bifurcation secondary-flow CFD
not yet connected to historical RL workers; old physics preserved

primary_evaluation.success_definition: all assigned clots completely cleared, unchanged
primary_evaluation.other_13_scenarios: secondary robustness report; do not pool changed and legacy physics
